response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional software engineering depth with 15+ years of progressive experience, strong distributed systems expertise (managing millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby), and clear technical leadership capability at Staff level, he fails to meet a critical minimum qualification: 8 years of C++ programming. His resume shows only ~6 months of professional C++ experience at National Instruments (2014-2015) plus a thesis project. His career pattern as a polyglot generalist selecting optimal tools for each job directly conflicts with the C++-core expertise required for technical leadership on a cloud compute platform.
strengths: Demonstrated expertise with large-scale distributed systems and high-performance infrastructure (microservices handling millions of requests/sec, low-latency systems, real-time processing)
Proven technical leadership and mentorship capability at Staff level, with clear evidence of establishing best practices (TDD, CI/CD, code workshops) and steering complex technical projects
Extensive infrastructure and DevOps background including Docker, Kubernetes, cloud architecture (AWS CDK), and system administration across multiple platforms
concerns: Critical disqualification: Role requires 8 years of C++ programming; candidate has approximately 6 months of professional C++ experience, falling far short of minimum requirement
Career pattern emphasizes polyglot full-stack generalism across JavaScript, TypeScript, DLang, Java rather than deep specialization in systems-level C++ programming required for platform leadership
No evidence of 2+ years leading cloud or DevOps engineering teams, or owning production cloud architecture decisions for mission-critical platforms
